decision: Promote the forced-residency global-attention specialization directly to one paired exact endpoint only when the exact H200 component mechanism passes.
hypothesis: Capping the unchanged 32x64 global head-512 kernel at 128 registers/thread admits two CTAs per H200 SM; added local-memory/L2 spill traffic is cheaper than the latency hidden by the measured one-CTA residency because DRAM and tensor activity are low and L2 has headroom.
falsifier: Reject without endpoint promotion if any numerical gate fails, the exact candidate is less than 5% faster, or NCU does not prove at most 128 registers/thread and at least two CTAs/SM by both register and shared-memory limits.
arm_policy: One admitted component process may contain warmups, timing repetitions, and the single NCU capture. Ordinary pre-invocation wiring failures are repaired in place and do not consume the arm. Endpoint execution is conditional on component_pass.
